# Prime EPC & Design Consultants

> Independent, accredited Domestic & Commercial Energy Assessors (DEA / NDEA) and Electrical Safety Inspectors based at 17 Bromwich Street, Bolton, BL2 1JF. Serving Greater Manchester, Merseyside, Lancashire, and Cheshire across 16 regional hubs within a 50-mile radius. Same-day survey bookings and urgent EPC reports available.

## Core Services & Pricing Structure (GBP)
- [Domestic EPC Assessments](https://www.primeepcdesign.co.uk/domestic-epc): EPC certificate from £50 (tiered by property size, bedrooms, and extensions). Same-day bookings available. Conducted to UK RdSAP 10 standards for house sales, urgent conveyancing exchanges, Buy-to-Let and Green Mortgage remortgages (`book epc for remortgage`), 10-year renewals, and private rentals. Valid for 10 years.
- [EPC Near Me — Instant Local Booking](https://www.primeepcdesign.co.uk/epc-near-me): Local GPS and postcode matcher covering 16 North West regions for homeowners and agents searching for an urgent EPC near them, same-day survey slots, and fast digital reports.
- [Commercial EPC Assessments](https://www.primeepcdesign.co.uk/commercial-epc): Starting from £144. Non-domestic Level 3 and Level 4 SBEM calculations for retail shops, offices, restaurants, medical practices, and industrial warehouses. Covers new leases, lease renewals, SIPP/SSAS pensions, and Commercial MEES Band E compliance.
- [Landlord EICR Electrical Safety Reports](https://www.primeepcdesign.co.uk/eicr): Starting from £110 (tiered by consumer unit circuits). BS 7671 18th Edition periodic inspection and testing required every 5 years under the Electrical Safety Standards in the Private Rented Sector (England) Regulations 2020, including 5-year EICR renewals and change-of-tenancy checks.
- [Landlord EPC + EICR Compliance Package](https://www.primeepcdesign.co.uk/landlord-certificates): Single-visit combined inspection covering both the domestic EPC and 5-year EICR electrical report on one invoice. Ideal for HMO licensing, Selective Licensing, and 2030 EPC Band C preparation.
- [Bulk & Portfolio EPC Orders](https://www.primeepcdesign.co.uk/bulk-epc): Custom multi-property volume discounts for portfolio landlords, letting agents, block managers, build-to-rent operators, and housing associations. Tailored quotes based on unit volume and postcode clustering, with free local branch key collection and consolidated invoicing.
- [CAD Floor Plans & Lease Plans](https://www.primeepcdesign.co.uk/floor-plans-drafting): RICS Gross Internal Area (GIA) laser-measured 2D and 3D marketing floor plans for Rightmove/Zoopla listings, council HMO & Selective Licensing room-size submissions, and Land Registry commercial lease plans.
- [BS 7671 Electrical Design](https://www.primeepcdesign.co.uk/electrical-design): CAD electrical layouts, cable sizing schedules, BS 5266 emergency lighting, and BS 5839 fire detection drawings for new builds, extensions, HMOs, and commercial fit-outs (Building Regulations Part P & Part L).
- [Pricing Guide](https://www.primeepcdesign.co.uk/pricing): Transparent breakdown of direct surveyor rates and bulk discount options.
- [Compliance FAQs](https://www.primeepcdesign.co.uk/faq): Practical answers on urgent same-day EPC surveys, booking an EPC for a remortgage, RdSAP 10 checks, EICR codes (C1, C2, C3, FI), and the UK Warm Homes Plan 1 October 2030 EPC Band C target (£10,000 cost cap).
